name: App mark assembles into the full wordmark
looks: A glowing app icon sits above two letters of the name, a soft ring pulsing behind it. The remaining letters drop in to complete the wordmark, and a short tagline and subline fade in beneath it.
build: wordmark-assemble: letters land with blur clearing to sharp, delay growing with distance from the centre; the icon's ring is a looping low-opacity pulse independent of the letter stagger. The tagline reveals with a clipPath wipe after the last letter lands.
sound: A soft tick per letter, a swell under the tagline.
prompt: Open on the product's icon alone with a soft pulsing glow behind it, then complete the name letter by letter beside it, and settle on a short one-line tagline that names what the product is for.
